name: gql-learning-lab
description: A hands-on Apollo Federation 2 project that simulates the **Daily Log** feature of a construction-management platform (modeled on Procore). One supergraph, many subgraphs, each owning its own data. The goal is learning by doing: entities, `@key`, `@external` / `@requires`, header propagation, cross-subgraph auth, query plans, and the N+1 problem as it actually appears in a federated graph.
